# Tim Fetter

Tim Fetter is a WordPress and front-end developer who builds responsive, editor-friendly websites, reusable ACF Blocks, and polished front-end UI examples for agencies, designers, and small businesses.

## Focus

- WordPress theme development
- ACF Pro Blocks
- Reusable WordPress sections
- Responsive front-end implementation
- Editor-friendly page-building workflows
- UI prototypes and interaction states
- Website cleanup, polish, and ongoing support

## Key pages

- [Home](https://timfetter.com/): Overview of services and fit.
- [Work](https://timfetter.com/work/): Selected WordPress, front-end UI, and client examples.
- [Reusable WordPress Sections](https://timfetter.com/acf-block-system-for-editor-friendly-wordpress-builds/): ACF Block examples built for flexible, editor-friendly WordPress sites.
- [Editor Experience & Handoff](https://timfetter.com/editor-experience-handoff/): Examples of client-friendly editing workflows and handoff considerations.
- [Contact](https://timfetter.com/contact/): Project inquiry page.

## Reusable WordPress section examples

- Page Banner
- Flexible Feature Section
- Filtered Content Grid
- Content Switcher
- Comparison Cards
- Proof Cards

## Front-end UI examples

- Client Project Timeline
- Project Scope Estimator
- Content Approval Checklist

## Best description

Tim helps agencies, designers, and small businesses turn designs or content needs into clean, maintainable WordPress interfaces with thoughtful editing experiences.
